summary: Updated tests for the title limit change from 120 to 200 characters across backend and frontend. Typecheck and both full suites pass. Vitest's GitHub reporter hit a read-only summary path, so I ran with the default reporter. I didn't run the coverage command.

files.reason: New test asserts the CREATE TABLE statement declares title VARCHAR(200).

Boundary moved to 200 (accepted) and 201 (rejected), plus a case where trimmed length is over 200. The old 121-char rejection assertion was intentionally changed. Also updated the 121 payload in router.test.ts to 201.
Limit and message updated to 200: 201 chars is rejected with the new message, and exactly 200 chars after trimming is accepted.
The 422 error message assertion now expects 'title up to 200 characters'.

review.notes: Four existing assertions were revised for the intended 120→200 change and one new database test was added. The new validator case with extra inner whitespace is a 203-character title, so it overlaps the 201 case a little.
